paper_title: Constraining Light QCD Axions with Isolated Neutron Star Cooling
suggested_experiment_name: Isolated Neutron Star Cooling (light QCD axion NGS envelope thinning)
coupling_convention: 1/f_a in GeV^-1 (inverse axion decay constant), exactly as plotted on the y-axis; x is m_a in eV. Plot is transposed vs standard AxionMass convention.
notes: Astrophysical bound on light QCD axions from isolated neutron star cooling; does NOT assume axion is dark matter (dm_density null). Result is an excluded band in the (m_a, 1/f_a) plane (Fig. 5), bounded by NGS formation requirements and envelope-thinning conditions. This is a coupling-independent bound on the axion mass-decay-constant plane, hence AxionMass. Numerical (m_a, f_a) points are rough estimates read from the exclusion band in Fig. 5; the paper provides no numerical table, so values are approximate. Excluded region roughly spans m_a ~ 1e-16 to 1e-5 eV with corresponding f_a ~ 1e10-1e17 GeV.
